Hello, Orion.
Please send the report.
The order contains 12 boxes and costs $45.
Send the Lyra report to Orion and NVIDIA in Seattle.

Today we reviewed the transcription service and agreed on a practical plan for the next release. First we will collect representative recordings from several microphones in a quiet room. Then we will repeat the same sentences with background noise and compare the results against an approved baseline. Every recording should include a carefully checked reference transcript and a clear description of the environment. We will track accuracy and recognition time separately so that a faster engine does not hide a loss of quality. Finally we will review the failed cases, document the limitations, and decide whether the release is ready for everyday dictation.
We should finish the review tomorrow after the team meeting.
I need one more thing before we finish.
